tagline: Even the strong ones need somewhere to fall.
story: When the Strong One Breaks is about the quiet weight of always being expected to hold everything together. It's a song for anyone who's been the steady hand, the safe place, or the person everyone calls — and has wondered who will be there when they need someone.
title: When the Strong One Breaks
description: Some people spend their lives being the one everyone else leans on. This song is for the moments when carrying it all becomes too much — and for the reminder that strength doesn't mean you have to carry it alone.
